item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02170","case1_error":"Treats selling price as construction cost, then subtracts the extra construction expense twice when calculating additional profit.","case2_error":"Assigns all annual birthday and Christmas presents to each half-year, ignoring their actual dates.","reason":"The first confuses financial quantities and double-counts an expense; the second duplicates annual events across time periods.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02171","case1_error":"Uses four bags as four peanuts, omitting the 30 peanuts per bag conversion.","case2_error":"Treats the number of 20-gram batches as grams of butter, omitting five grams of butter per batch.","reason":"Both mistake a batch count for the quantity contained or produced, omitting the per-batch multiplier.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02172","case1_error":"Inserts an unsupported $3,000 tax expense; the stated tax rate applied to $5,000 pretax profit gives $1,000.","case2_error":"Uses the 22 small lights as the large-light count despite correctly stating that large lights equal twice 12.","reason":"The first supplies an unexplained incorrect intermediate amount; the second substitutes another category's count into a calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02173","case1_error":"Invents an initial count of zero and updates the jar inconsistently with removals and returns.","case2_error":"Moves the second five chips to a separate day and delays daily ten-chip consumption, adding an extra day.","reason":"The first uses an unsupported initial quantity and inconsistent inventory changes; the second misassigns events to days.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02174","case1_error":"Reports salary minus necessities as taxes, omitting the $18 remaining balance and mislabeling intermediate quantities.","case2_error":"Reports only movie and sports charges, omitting the $15 basic service charge from the total.","reason":"Both omit a required monetary component from the requested calculation; their displayed arithmetic is correct.","judgment":"same"}]}
